notes.title: Update 0.10.0.1261 - Introducing BattlEye Anti-Cheat, Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/552ece052930dd28e0a5ef56fd4ec6a1efc6a59c.jpg[/img]

Hey Folks,

In our ongoing efforts to deal with reports of cheats in DUCKSIDE, with today's update we have changed our anticheat system and integrated BattlEye, a leading anti-cheat system used in a number of the most popular competitive shooters.

BattlEye runs at the kernel level, allowing it to proactively detect and ban cheaters in real time while staying light on system resources. It also provides custom security solutions tailored for DUCKSIDE, ensuring deeper protection against evolving cheats.

We’re working closely with BattlEye to identify and remove cheaters faster than we were able to previously, which will result in a much more enjoyable and fair experience for everyone. 

[hr][/hr]

Let us know what you think of the update in the comments, and tell us what you'd like to see added to the game in the future. We've got a bunch of cool stuff in the works, and can't wait to share what's coming up with you all!

notes.title: January Update - Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/054833098f40c76975ec3be85321e281bd4e78a3.jpg[/img]

Hey Everyone!

We’re seeing out the first month of the year with a new update for DUCKSIDE, which includes the implementation of the first iteration of one of our roadmap goals; weapon durability, alongside a bunch of balancing tweaks, QOL improvements and general optimization.

Check out the full update notes below! 

[h1]What’s New:[/h1]
 
[h3]Durability feature for melee weapons[/h3]

The “Durability” feature is introduced for melee weapons. We will continue to extend this feature and fine-tune the ‘durability’ levels, while also adding a repair option in the near future.

[h3]Explosive Charge Placements:[/h3]

Players can now throw small and large explosive charges onto walls from a distance, similar to the satchel charge mechanic in other games. This replaces the previous method of directly placing C4 on walls, adding a new layer of strategy and skill to breaching tactics.

[h3]Added a second exit to the submarine[/h3] 

Previously, the submarine had only one exit, making it easy to camp. A second exit has been introduced to improve balance and reduce camping.

[h3]Improved NPC AI[/h3]

NPCs now attempt to take cover behind walls, crates, and other objects instead of standing still or running unpredictably. 

[h3]Scope Sensitivity Options [/h3]

A new sensitivity setting has been added specifically for scoped weapons. Players can now fine-tune their mouse sensitivity separately for collimator sights and 4x scopes, allowing for more precise aiming customization.

[h3]In-Game Steam Ban Feature [/h3]

Administrators and Moderators can now issue Steam game bans directly from the in-game admin panel.

[h3]Enhanced Player Marker System[/h3]
 [list]
[*] The team marker system has been overhauled to reduce confusion:
[*] Players can now place one group-visible marker using Ctrl + Left Mouse Button
[*] Each player can set up to 5 personal markers
[*] Team leaders have the ability to remove group markers placed by other team members
[/list]
[h3]General improvements:[/h3]

Implemented some visual fixes and general optimization 

[hr][/hr]
Let us know what you think of the update in the comments, and tell us what you'd like to see added to the game in the future! 

Don't forget to join the conversation over on Discord and keep up to date with all things DUCKSIDE by following us on social media:

notes.title: The Christmas Update is available now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/cca28f6c38c1210e2eca402a7f93cbcd4ba0151b.jpg[/img]

[quote]The festive season is upon us! So for their first Christmas on the DUCKSIDE archipelago, the Ducks are celebrating it in style with a Christmas Update! 

Quacked with new features, holiday-themed items, a brand new monument and more. Let’s unwrap the highlights! Read through the end for the full patch notes![/quote]

[h3]New Monument:[/h3]

Somehow, someone got a submarine stranded in the middle of the desert. Gross incompetence of whoever was captaining that submarine aside, it holds some valuable loot for anyone brave enough to venture to its heart and extract it…

[h3]New Events:[/h3]

Get ready for some merry mayhem!

1️⃣ [b]Christmas Carol Ghost Event: [/b]

Who ya gonna call? Not Scrooge, that’s for sure. The Ghostly Ducks of Christmas yet to come are haunting bases across the archipelago. 

Drops new gatherable resource
Snow Piece: Used for crafting Xmas themed items!

2️⃣ [b]Santa’s Sled Shooting Event:[/b]

Santa (or a feathered non-union equivalent) is visiting to spread joy and cultivate carnage.
While shooting "Santa's” sleigh would usually get you put pretty high up on the naughty list, it is the most efficient way of getting your hands on his loot…

The bravest ducks may also find even rarer loot in the sleigh itself…  

[h3]New Cosmetics & Decorations[/h3]

[b]Santa Hat:[/b] I mean, what other kind of hat do you expect at Christmas…?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/f80221d440a3c613bc6416afd31092b26cdb6629.png[/img]
[b]Deer Antlers:[/b] Become an honorary member of Santa's reindeer alongside Rudolph, Donner, Dancer and whatever the other ones are called!

[b]Snowman[/b] Keep a cool head in even the toughest situations! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/8543806c8bf649a2352d43c17ca14b72dc8d1451.png[/img]
[b]Krampus Hat:[/b] For all the ducks out there that still enjoy christmas but wanna maintain their edgy and mysterious persona.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/5f802f8b6045abe98310665a940a84280dac1538.jpg[/img]
[b]Door Skin:[/b] Nothing says “It’s Christmas” like a wreath on the door of a base that you’re about to turn to rubble.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/44a41d18c8147ae27d8d2855debe7f7fb44e0aa0.jpg[/img]
[b]Fireplace[/b] Warm those webbed feet by the fire as you await the arrival of santa (or a raider) with a Christmas Fireplace
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/bc6af1af183ff7bf6e1da9633939b8b08afa2ee5.jpg[/img]
[b]And more! :[/b] Christmas lights, candy cane weapons, streamer shotguns and Christmas tree shrines can also be crafted and found throughout the archipelago!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/bdaf0c225b66fab980dbd9cf88b6bd42ee2d0e5c.png[/img]

(Please note that you don’t actually get anything out of it other than the satisfaction of having blown up a snowman with a rocket launcher)

Snowmen can be built by default.

notes.title: DUCKSIDE | October Development Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/db73930cd3cfb8b28c10b5ed164131c20abaf045.jpg[/img]

[quote]Hey all!

It’s been just over a month since we launched DUCKSIDE into Early Access and we’re absolutely blown away by the response we’ve seen so far!

Today, we’re going to update you on what’s going on at the DUCKSIDE HQ, with some details about upcoming major additions, our next patch and some organizational improvements we’ve made to improve the player experience in DUCKSIDE…[/quote]

[u][h2]Addressing cheaters/hackers[/h2][/u]

First off, we have now established [b]a dedicated cheat prevention admin team[/b] to manage player reports. Previously, we had no dedicated personnel to handle the deluge of reports we had been receiving, with the team members instead dealing with them on an ad-hoc basis. With the introduction of our new admin team, we are in a much better position to address player reports, cheats and hackers in a more organized and timely manner.

[u][h2]Immediate focuses:[/h2][/u]

[b]Implementation of a new Anti-cheat system[/b]

EAC has been holding the fort for us since our first beta all the way back in April, but there are some essential features we need for this style of game that the platform doesn’t offer at this time. So in the interest of improving the security of the game and maintaining our community's enjoyment of DUCKSIDE, we will soon be implementing a new anti-cheat system which has proven successful in other similar titles that we hope will be more suited to our needs.

[b]New monument - Stranded submarine[/b]

The Early Access release saw the introduction of the Oil Rig, which marked a new approach to how we design our monuments and is something we will be continuing with our next major monument: The Stranded Submarine.

Work is well underway and we hope to have this introduced either before the end of the year, or early 2025. We will keep you updated on our efforts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/1252f96b55b84c7bcc81f26ec459dc00b63894be.png[/img]

[b]Tool durability system:[/b]

At this moment in time, tools don’t degrade with use, making eco raiding a lengthy but extremely viable option for anyone who wants to save their resources and are willing to dedicate their time to it. The team are working to implement a weapon durability system that will ideally shift the raiding emphasis back to designated raiding equipment, requiring more skill, planning and rarer resources.

[b]Thanksgiving Update/Event[/b]

These ducks love a national holiday, especially if it means that other birds have to deal with the humans wrath for a few days....

New hats, new skins, new base decoration items and more are coming to DUCKSIDE in celebration of Thanksgiving this November! 

Check out some concept art 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/4d742e7076e3cab6fe052e28b20c119e97ffc3c9.jpg[/img]

[u][h2]Next Update[/h2][/u]
Finally, let’s take an Early look at what's planned for the next upcoming patch which we’ve built around some of the most common reports and feedback we’ve received from players over the last few weeks.

[b]We’re hoping to release this update later this week or early next:[/b]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixing a bug with placing a floor door
[*] Fixing a bug with determining stability in construction (objects could hang in the air after destruction).
[*] Fixing a bug with a triangular floor, where it was impossible to place walls under an improved floor.
[*] Fixing dismantling triangular doors without an idol.
[*] Fixing dismantling objects (e.g., workbenches) not giving crafting kits in the base without an idol.
[*] Fixing that there was no animation of a character's shot when aiming for a local player.
[/list]
[b]Gameplay Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Shot validation - fewer missed shots.
[*] Removed the check for player spawn, so they are not teleported to a random spawn during a collision.
[*] Molotov will now damage sleeping ducks.
[*] Adding zoom while aiming.
[*] Base registration improvements.
[/list]
[b]Anti-Cheat and Reporting[/b]
[list]
[*] Players will no longer be able to spam reports.
[*] Anti-cheat will now show report ID, allowing users to appeal to EAC with it.
[/list]
[b]Map and Content Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Map - adding 2 cave systems.
[/list]
[b]Weapon Modifications[/b]
[list]
[*] Weapon modifications: bullet speed increase, recoil change.
[/list]

This is a tentative list, and we will be monitoring player feedback to further identify anything that we can resolve in time for the patch. So if you have anything you feel needs urgently addressing, please don’t hesitate to let us know!

notes.title: DUCKSIDE | July Development Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/5db0ea884e0f40113f1f231c1c6b5e29b6c2febe.jpg[/img]
[quote]It’s been a few weeks since the second DUCKSIDE beta concluded now, so we thought it would be a great time to update you all on what’s going on behind the scenes and some of our plans for the coming months![/quote]

[hr][/hr]

While we’ve shared in our previous announcement some of our short term focuses (much of which is now either complete or well in development) today, we’re going to share some of the longer term development plans and content that we’ll be working on to bring us through to release:

[h2]New Biomes[/h2]

Grass and trees are great and all, but would ducks even bother migrating if they had some massive desert expanses just a few kilometers down the road, or glacial planes on the other side of a local mountain? Who knows, we’re not duck experts, we’re game developers and we want to add some cool new areas for the ducks to explore without them getting too tired, so we’re going to do that. 

Alongside the visual changes we talked about in our last development update, DUCKSIDE will be seeing some major visual improvements and additional natural diversity over the coming months!

[h2]New Monuments[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/249d41886b4d8b33ea8db075c07e0c1e1848cfa5.jpg[/img]

The humans are busy building some new stuff to die in at the hands of some recently sentience-imbued ducks, even going so far as to build off shore now, like that’s going to deter flying creatures that love water... 

But yeah, we’re working on some cool new POIs to explore, and we’d love to get some suggestions from you folks for additional ones that might fit into this world! 

[h2]Mixing Table[/h2]

Ducks only have so much time in the day, so spending that time crafting items en masse is time that could be spent killing things or building cool nests wasted. 

Therefore, in the interest of spending more time killing and building, we are introducing a mixing table to speed up the crafting of large amounts of items.

[h2]Character Controller Rework[/h2]

Telepathic ducks really drive home how crazy the situation has gotten over on the DUCKSIDE Archipelago, but having guns floating around the ducks head detracts a little from the gritty, realistic and somber tone we're going for with this game, so in the interest of being taken seriously once award season comes around, we're working to have the ducks actually hold their weapons.

[h2]Shotgun Trap[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LtRdw0V.gif[/img]

Trespassing is a crime, and crimes should result in consequences. We feel that being blown to smithereens unexpectedly is a suitable consequence for ducks breaking into your house, so we’ve added shotgun traps to the game.

If you’re a nice, law abiding duck, you won’t have to worry about these too much. If you’re the kind of duck that broke into my house and stole all my metal fragments and my crossbow during the last beta, you’re the reason this happened and you should feel bad.

[h2]And more![/h2]

Obviously, these are just some of the cooler things we’re working on but we’re also coming up with new ideas everyday, and working on a ton of other awesome stuff that we’ll share when the time is right!

[h2]DUCKSIDE when?![/h2]

Finally, the question you folks have been asking since roughly 0.36s after the last beta ended: “When can we play DUCKSIDE again?”

Well, we're working away on the next build of the game as we speak and of course are now making some plans on how to get all your feedback on the latest changes and additions ahead of the official launch, so stay tuned for news!

[hr][/hr]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/r0uXkJC.gif[/img]

Don't forget to join the conversation over on [url=https://discord.gg/2umax49Zvu]Discord[/url] and keep up to date with all things DUCKSIDE by following us on social media:

[*] [url=https://twitter.com/PlayDUCKSIDE]Twitter[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/playduckside/]Instagram[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Duckside/]Reddit[/url]
[/list][/i]
See you in the skies, very soon!

- tinyBuild Riga

notes.title: WIPE #2, server update, blueprints stay
notes.notes:
A good day to everyone in the flock!

We are initiating the second wipe at around the time of this update. Yesterday's wipe helped us identify a few core issues. 

If you experienced lag, in a nutshell the reason for it is a combination of 3 factors: too many players, too many bases, and too many active NPCs. One of these at a time the servers handle no problem. When you have 2, it becomes a slight issue. When you have all 3 - that's when the game becomes unplayable.

The fixes for these 3 are fairly straightforward and require a bit of development time, which the team is working on right now.

A temporary fix to the issues is reducing player density. This is what today's wipe will achieve. We've received a lot of feedback that high pop servers are a bit too much chaos, so we hit 2 ducks with one stone here. After today's wipe, the max player count will be slightly reduced. 

- Bases and loot will be wiped
- Blueprints WILL NOT BE WIPED. You keep your blueprint progression.

Through the upcoming week we will be working on client fixes to optimize traffic (so that NPCs and players don't strangle server performance) and we are working on figuring out base decay. The issue we have now is that abandoned bases do not despawn, so I appreciate the community coming together yesterday to "clean" servers from dead bases. There will be a system to address this issue, most likely in the form of base decay. 

Please let us know on [url=https://discord.gg/2umax49Zvu]DISCORD[/url] or on the forums what you think about the new player density, and we will see you in-game!

notes.title: FIRST WIPE and general update on the flock
notes.notes:
Greetings from the flock!

First off an enormous, heartfelt THANK YOU to everyone who joined the beta so far. We have over 85k players right now. This is way beyond our expectations. 

On Thursday we had to panic increase the amount of game servers. By about 5 times. That was a fun night.

We did a couple of hotfixes to both the server and the client. There's an enormous backlog we're working on.

Today we wiped all servers. The goal of the test was to see stability of game servers, understand what kind of issues we get at scale. This was the reason to wipe said servers, because we finally reached the critical point in terms of the amount of buildings on any given server. Usually persistent world games like this have a wipe schedule, which we couldn't anticipate going into the beta. So today's wipe will help us understand how the map size works with player density, alongside the max player cap per server.

Immediate points of focus are:

- Network optimization, so you players experience smooth movement when servers fill up with more players
- Exploit fixes, i.e. clipping through walls and getting loot
- Balance fixes, such as not all players understanding that tier1 is actually easy to raid. Yes, much like many of you I've seen a lot of bases with tier3 workbenches and not upgraded walls. A simple solution here is to decrease the damage done by melee weapons to tier1 walls, and also make tier1 walls "look" much less safe, i.e. have see-through gaps. 

We are seeing and gathering all the feedback provided. The simplest way to report issues / share feedback is right here on the Steam Forums or on our super active DISCORD. 

Thank you
- Team tinyBuild
